name: Grassy Top Mountain
generated_description:
Grassy Top Mountain rises to 3,258 feet in South Carolina. The Grassy Top Mountain Trail covers 0.1 miles with about 82 feet of elevation gain — a steep, sustained climb.

Getting There

The trailhead is at 35.15929, -82.52306 (tap for driving directions). It's roughly 30 miles south of Asheville, North Carolina. Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

When to Go

This trail is hikeable most of the year. Summer brings heat and humidity — carry extra water — while fall and spring offer the most comfortable conditions. Ice is possible on shaded stretches in mid-winter.

Know Before You Go

Download the GPX track from this page before you go — cell coverage is unreliable in the mountains and a saved route works offline in any GPS app. Conditions change: verify current access, closures and weather with the official land manager before you go.
